summary() returns an array, not {backends}; API summary is governanceAdmitted=null, runnable=false, installed=null, blockedReason=API_TEXT_ONLY_NO_TOOL_EXECUTION. Preserve those distinctions in assertions.
Pass installed:true explicitly when asserting CLI installation; _resolveBackends defaults this field to null.
additionalStaticFindings: Fixing the missing factory alone would not make this candidate pass: summary shape and several API admission/execution assertions also contradict frozen source.

sourceAnchors.text:
summary() {
    return this._backends.map((b) => ({
      type: b.type,
      kind: b.isCLI ? "cli" : "api",
      provider: b.provider || b.type,
      weight: b.weight,
      installed: b.isCLI ? (b.installed ?? null) : null,
      configured: true,
      governanceAdmitted: b.isCLI ? false : null,
      requiresAuthenticatedRun: true,
      dispatchable: !b.isCLI,
      runnable: false,
      executionMode: b.isCLI ? "blocked" : "text-only",
      blockedReason: b.isCLI
        ? AGENT_ROUTER_ERROR.EXTERNAL_MODEL_INGRESS_UNATTESTED
        : "API_TEXT_ONLY_NO_TOOL_EXECUTION",
      alternative: "cc agent",
    }));
